title: Bring your business to {brand}. It's free.
lead: Get your own website, reach the people who look for businesses on {brand}, and run bookings, orders and payments from one place.
benefitSiteTitle: Your own website, live in minutes
benefitSiteText: Your business gets its own site with your logo, address and what you offer, ready the moment you sign up.
benefitCustomersText: Once we have checked your business, it appears on {brand} next to the others people search, book and buy from.
benefitPanelTitle: Run it all from one panel
benefitPanelText: Bookings, orders, customers, payments and your team, all in one place.
typesHeading: What kind of business do you run?
stepAccountText: Sign up with your email, or continue with Google or Apple.
stepBusinessText: Its name, phone and address take a few minutes. Your NIPT can wait.
stepLiveText: Your own site works at once. {brand} lists you after a quick check by our team.
closingText: It's free, and you can set up the rest of your business right after.
